面宝来自一个特别的地方，面市镇，一座美好的小镇。他是米头最想的大明星，面市镇里一切皆由面条营造，包括超酷的车和马，也包括整座山。
米头来自老米镇，是一位刚发想几款点心事，他学火中枪，设计了一个火线舞台，邀请面宝来参加……面宝不来了，舞台上只剩下13根面条头。
最终，乌云散去，面宝现身，他原谅了米头，并且与米头一起携手演出，让他赢得了属于自己的掌声。

She authored "Creative Market" and "Creative Market 2: Playing Big Dreams," which led the trend of "creative markets" and simultaneously inspired the widespread development of creative markets in China.

Noodle Boy comes from a special place, Noodle Town, a beautiful little town. He is the big star that Mi Tou has always dreamed of. Everything in Noodle Town is made of noodles, including cool cars and horses, as well as the entire mountain.
Mi Tou comes from Old Mi Town. He recently came up with a few new pastry ideas. He learned the fire gun technique and designed a fiery stage, inviting Noodle Boy to join... But Noodle Boy didn't come, leaving only 13 noodle heads on the stage.
